title: The Vacuum as a Jammed Elastic Solid, and the Speed of Light as Its Elastic-Wave Speed
abstract: This white paper presents Volume Particle (VP) theory — a model in which the vacuum is a jammed granular lattice: space is filled by infinitely rigid, fully packing constituents frozen at random close packing, so the vacuum behaves as an elastic solid. “Soft” and quantum phenomena are treated as event structures and relaxation/failure rates on this rigid medium, not as intrinsic softness. paper_abstract_source:
This white paper presents  Volume Particle (VP)  theory — a model in which the vacuum is a  jammed granular lattice : space is filled by infinitely rigid, fully packing constituents frozen at random close packing, so the vacuum behaves as an elastic  solid . “Soft” and quantum phenomena are treated as event structures and relaxation/failure rates on this rigid medium, not as intrinsic softness. The document carries, in the same file, a complete reproducibility specification (LOCK schema, derivation chain, Gate verdicts, cross-validation, and a DOI-anchored code/data bundle). 
 The physical foundation is established by closed form and by parameter-free simulation. The collective stiffness is  measured , not assumed (the packing self-organises to φ_jam≈ 0.64 with contact number through the isostatic z=2d=6, no physical constant in the input); at that marginal point the  relaxed  shear modulus vanishes while the bulk modulus stays finite — shown here along  five independent observables  (static modulus; vibrational ω^*→0 with R²=0.997; viscosity divergence; athermal-quasistatic cross-check; yield stress) — so a single longitudinal speed survives, c²=B/ρ:  the speed of light is the lattice elastic-wave speed . Linear dispersion ω=cq gives a wavelength λ=c/ν, and one 2π phase winding fixes the quantum diameter D=2πλ/A, where the amplification A=a_med/g^* (median spacing over the critical percolation throat) is a  parameter-free lattice output . A rotational-unjamming inflow — a marginal packing has zero shear reserve, so rotation breaks contacts and ejects material through a single nozzle — fixes the proton radius as a  globally stable attractor , rₚ=(2/π)λ_(C,p)=0.8412 fm (CODATA charge radius 0.8414 fm). 
 The dimensionless content then follows from rotational averaging and lattice counting, with no fitted coefficient. Two rectification constants are fixed by elementary integrals: α=⟨|cosθ|⟩_(2D)=2/π and δ=1/π², with α/δ=2π. The proton core is the integer count 82=81+1, where 81=#x²+y²+z²≤ 6=3⁴ and the R²=7 shell is empty by Legendre's three-square theorem. An n-fold event-rate law νₙ=nπ²⁽ⁿ⁻¹⁾ gives the electron rate νₑ=1 and the proton rate νₚ=3π⁴, so the proton-to-electron mass ratio is mₚ/mₑ=(α/δ)νₚ=2π· 3π⁴=6π⁵≈ 1836 (within 19 ppm of CODATA), and the Higgs-mass coefficient is 5π (six cube faces minus one gauge degree of freedom), giving m_H=hc/(a· 5π). A single gauge-dimension lemma, dim(R^N/span1)=N-1, underlies both the proton exponent and the Higgs coefficient. Ideal-limit forms of the same framework are carried through blackbody/Planck and Casimir-style calibration routes. 
 Results are graded without inflation:  Forced  (geometry and integrals, no free coefficient),  Calibrated  (dimension-bearing values carrying a single empirical length anchor, λ_ref=632.99 nm, cross-checked by an independent geometric route to 0.16%), and  Open  (explicitly not claimed). The dynamical results above (single speed, forced radius, amplification) are  verified ; the numerical ladder 3π⁴→6π⁵ rests on  one  definitional identification, of the same status as the definitions of α and δ. The paper does  not  derive the QED fine-structure constant α_em≈ 1/137 (it is taken as an open input), and — by an explicit rule — agreement with measured values is never used to declare the underlying axioms or definitions “true.” 
 The operational rule is the one-way flow  LOCK → derive → Gate :
(i) lock inputs and meanings (no post-hoc tuning),
(ii) derive quantities using only transformations permitted by the LOCK, and
(iii) restrict the admissible status of results through Gate verdicts  PASS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE .
This version locks the canonical length anchor D_anch, proton radius rₚ, realization scales a,Δ t, and rectification constants (α,δ), and derives event-rate relations and length–time–mass/force scale mappings, including ideal-limit forms used in blackbody/Casimir-style calibration routes. 
 DOI (text + code + data bundle):   10.5281/zenodo.17932566 .
